craft_notes: SthAyin: Ananda as forgotten-treasure-found (C1 rasa); bhakti as prApti (finding); vyabhicAri harSa of burden-lowering. Firing: triple-refusal catalogue (rows pile negations — wealth/women/splendour, then pictured-light); burden image left standing (row 10); end-weight light-rise AFFIRMED (the refused word returns — ring closes the verse whether same-or-different). L4 = L3 verbatim: bluntness is the music; gilding would reintroduce exactly what the verse refuses.

lines: Bliss here is not wealth-middle-intoxication, nor like enjoying women,
nor lamp-sun-moon-made splendour-multitudes — nor even the light-rise.
Joy — difference gathered, freed in bliss-ground, like the lowering of a burden —
is the forgotten treasure found of the all-nonduality state: the light-rise.
